Cáit
5 out of 5 stars
🌸🖤the robe that accidentally turned me into a languid heiress🖤🌸
Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2026
Size: One SizeColor: Black
Verified Purchase

this has genuinely become one of those items that lives in constant rotation to the point where i briefly panic if it’s in the wash. i throw it on after showers, over pyjamas, while making coffee, while doing skincare, while standing dramatically by the window pretending i’m processing Very Important Emotional News from the year 1897. incredibly versatile emotional support garment.

the fabric has that lightweight silky feel without entering the terrifying territory of “one wrong movement and the seam dissolves into dust.” it drapes really nicely and moves in that floaty expensive-looking way where suddenly even carrying a laundry basket feels cinematic. the floral print is gorgeous in person too. soft romantic magnolia energy instead of loud chaotic hotel curtain energy, which i appreciated deeply.

also: pockets. actual usable pockets. not decorative little lies stitched onto the sides as a social experiment. i regularly carry my phone around in these pockets while wandering through the flat like a woman who owns inherited land and several emotionally distant horses.

the length is lovely too. i’m 5’3” and this still somehow manages to look elegant and floaty instead of like i escaped from a very glamorous choir rehearsal. the sleeves sit nicely as well and don’t immediately fall into your sink water every time you attempt to function as a human being for five consecutive minutes.

at this stage i own multiple colours because apparently my final form is “woman permanently swanning around in satin robes.” i wear them around the house, by the pool, while doing my makeup, during my unnecessarily elaborate iced chai rituals, all of it. romanticising your life sounds fake until you realise half the battle is simply refusing to wear spiritually depressing loungewear.

for $39.99 honestly this feels very fair within the current chaiconomy because one mediocre iced chai in manhattan now costs roughly the GDP of a minor kingdom. meanwhile this robe has survived endless lounging, skincare residue, existential pacing and several deeply unserious attempts at becoming the kind of person who journals at sunrise.

my only warning is that once you start wearing robes like this regularly, normal clothing begins to feel a bit hostile. suddenly you’re tying a satin sash at 2pm on a tuesday just to answer emails. i caught my reflection wearing this while holding a cucumber and fully understood how people end up moving to villas and speaking exclusively in cryptic wellness statements.

✨tl;dr✨ silky, lightweight, romantic and weirdly life-enhancing. excellent drape, pretty print, real pockets and extremely effective at convincing you your ordinary domestic activities are part of an arthouse film.

5 out of 5 stars
Silky and very comfortable I will be purchasing again
Reviewed in the United States on October 26, 2023
Size: One SizeColor: Gray
Verified Purchase

I am really in an old Hollywood glamour phase, and I am obsessed with flowy dressing gowns. I bought this one so that I could have a second when my other one is in the wash, but honestly this one is even better. It is very silky and soft. The fabric has a very nice drape - it hangs in that languid sort of way that makes you feel like you should be wearing feather slippers and have a cigarette holder in one hand. The stitching is good quality and the pockets are a nice little touch. I will say that the cut is a teensy bit large for me. The height is perfect (I'm 5'7"), and the sleeve length is also great (just over 3/4" and I have relatively long arms), but the width is a little large (I'm about a size 10-12 in dresses). It's not very noticeable, just not as fitted as I might have liked; when I tie the inner ties all the way together the drape is a little lopsided and there is still room to spare. That being said, it fits my needs perfectly. I love it and am considering getting another one.So beautiful I would love to get this in multiple colors
